# ELLE
> Fashion, beauty, culture, and celebrity news from ELLE, with runway coverage, shopping guides, and daily horoscopes.

ELLE is a digital fashion magazine covering designer collections, beauty trends, celebrity style, culture, politics, relationships, and astrology. The site combines reported features, service journalism, shopping recommendations, and visual coverage of runway shows and red carpets.

## Fashion
- [Fashion](https://www.elle.com/fashion/): Main fashion hub for trends, designer news, styling ideas, and industry coverage.
- [Trend Reports](https://www.elle.com/fashion/trend-reports/): Seasonal trend analysis, outfit inspiration, and emerging style movements.
- [Street Style](https://www.elle.com/fashion/street-style/): Street style photography and real-world fashion inspiration from major cities.
- [Celebrity Style](https://www.elle.com/fashion/celebrity-style/): Celebrity outfits, red carpet looks, and style breakdowns.
- [Fashion Week](https://www.elle.com/fashion/fashion-week/): Coverage of runway shows, collections, and fashion week highlights.
- [Shopping](https://www.elle.com/fashion/shopping/): Editor-curated fashion shopping guides, product picks, and wardrobe recommendations.

## Beauty
- [Beauty](https://www.elle.com/beauty/): Main beauty hub for skincare, makeup, hair, fragrance, and wellness-adjacent coverage.
- [Makeup & Skin Care](https://www.elle.com/beauty/makeup-skin-care/): Skincare routines, makeup trends, product reviews, and expert advice.
- [Hair](https://www.elle.com/beauty/hair/): Hair trends, cuts, color inspiration, and styling guidance.
- [Nails](https://www.elle.com/beauty/nails/): Nail art ideas, manicure trends, and polish recommendations.
- [Health & Fitness](https://www.elle.com/beauty/health-fitness/): Fitness, wellness, and healthy living content from a beauty-lifestyle perspective.
- [Beauty Awards](https://www.elle.com/beauty/gmp34421426/elle-beauty-awards-2020/): ELLE’s beauty awards coverage highlighting standout products and brands.

## Culture
- [Culture](https://www.elle.com/culture/): Main culture hub for entertainment, books, politics, and social commentary.
- [Celeb News](https://www.elle.com/culture/celebrities/): Celebrity interviews, relationship updates, and entertainment news.
- [Movies & TV](https://www.elle.com/culture/movies-tv/): Film and television coverage, reviews, interviews, and explainers.
- [Music](https://www.elle.com/culture/music/): Music news, artist profiles, and performance coverage.
- [Books](https://www.elle.com/culture/books/): Author interviews, reading lists, and literary features.
- [Career & Politics](https://www.elle.com/culture/career-politics/): Reporting on politics, work, power, and women’s leadership.

## Love & Life
- [Love & Life](https://www.elle.com/life-love/): Relationships, sex, wellness, travel, and personal life coverage.
- [Sex & Relationships](https://www.elle.com/life-love/sex-relationships/): Dating advice, relationship features, and intimacy-focused reporting.
- [Life & Love](https://www.elle.com/life-love/life/): Personal essays, lifestyle stories, and everyday living topics.
- [Travel](https://www.elle.com/life-love/travel/): Travel inspiration, destination guides, and hotel recommendations.
- [Sexual Health](https://www.elle.com/life-love/sex-relationships/advice/): Advice-driven relationship and sexual health content.

## Horoscopes
- [Horoscopes](https://www.elle.com/horoscopes/): Astrology hub with daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly horoscope content.
- [Daily Horoscopes](https://www.elle.com/horoscopes/daily/): Daily horoscope updates for every zodiac sign.
- [Weekly Horoscopes](https://www.elle.com/horoscopes/weekly/): Weekly astrology forecasts and sign-by-sign guidance.
- [Monthly Horoscopes](https://www.elle.com/horoscopes/monthly/): Monthly horoscope predictions for all zodiac signs.
- [Yearly Horoscopes](https://www.elle.com/horoscopes/yearly/): Annual astrology forecasts and long-range sign outlooks.
- [Love Horoscopes](https://www.elle.com/horoscopes/love/): Astrology focused on romance, compatibility, and relationships.

## Shopping & Product Guides
- [Best Products](https://www.elle.com/fashion/shopping/): Fashion product roundups and editor-approved shopping recommendations.
- [Best Beauty Products](https://www.elle.com/beauty/makeup-skin-care/): Beauty product recommendations across skincare, makeup, and tools.
- [Designer Shopping Guides](https://www.elle.com/fashion/shopping/): Luxury and contemporary fashion buying guides from ELLE editors.
- [Gift Guides](https://www.elle.com/fashion/shopping/): Seasonal gift ideas and curated product recommendations.
- [Home & Lifestyle Shopping](https://www.elle.com/life-love/shopping/): Lifestyle-oriented shopping picks for home, travel, and everyday use.

## Video & Visual Features
- [Video](https://www.elle.com/video/): ELLE video hub featuring interviews, beauty routines, and fashion features.
- [Runway Collections](https://www.elle.com/fashion/fashion-week/): Visual runway coverage and collection highlights from major designers.
- [Celebrity Covers](https://www.elle.com/culture/celebrities/): Cover stories, photo shoots, and celebrity feature packages.
- [Red Carpet Style](https://www.elle.com/fashion/celebrity-style/): Photo-driven red carpet coverage and outfit analysis.

## Special Franchises
- [Women in Hollywood](https://www.elle.com/culture/movies-tv/): Coverage of actresses, filmmakers, and women shaping entertainment.
- [Women in Politics](https://www.elle.com/culture/career-politics/): Profiles and reporting on influential women in public life.
- [Editors’ Picks](https://www.elle.com/fashion/shopping/): Recurring editor selections across fashion and beauty categories.
- [Cover Stories](https://www.elle.com/culture/celebrities/): Signature ELLE interviews and long-form celebrity profiles.

## Magazine & Brand
- [Homepage](https://www.elle.com/): ELLE front page featuring top stories across fashion, beauty, and culture.
- [Digital Issues](https://www.elle.com/uk/life-and-culture/culture/news/a26855/download-digital-edition-elle-magazine/): Information related to ELLE digital magazine editions.
- [Newsletter](https://www.elle.com/email/): Sign-up page for ELLE newsletters and recurring editorial updates.
- [About Hearst](https://www.elle.com/about/a41821438/about-hearst-magazines-and-yahoo/): Publisher and brand context for ELLE within Hearst Magazines.
